blocks.text: I have va I've got: egalik

O'zbekchada egalikni **bor** so'zi va egalik qo'shimchasi bilan aytamiz: «Mening mashina**m bor**», «Opamning ikki farzand**i bor**». Inglizchada «bor» so'zi yo'q — buning o'rniga ega + **have** fe'li ishlatiladi: I **have** a car. My sister **has** two children. Ya'ni o'zbekcha «menda ... bor» inglizchada «men ... ga egaman» shaklida quriladi. British English'da so'zlashuvda xuddi shu ma'noda **have got** ham juda ko'p ishlatiladi: I**'ve got** a car. Hozirgi zamonda **have** va **have got** ma'nosi bir xil.

Diqqat: **she's got** dagi **'s** — bu **has**, «is» emas. Qanday ajratish mumkin? Agar undan keyin **got** kelsa — has: She**'s got** a dog (= she has got). Agar sifat, joy yoki -ing kelsa — is: She**'s** tired, She**'s** working. **have got** dagi **got** alohida ma'no bermaydi, u faqat so'zlashuv rangi: I've got = I have.

items.text: We**'ve got** a lot of homework today.

items: **Narsalar**: I**'ve got** a laptop. They **have** a big house.
**Oila va do'stlar**: She **has** two sisters. We**'ve got** relatives in Bukhara.
**Tashqi ko'rinish**: He**'s got** blue eyes. Madina **has** long hair. — o'zbekchada: «uning ko'zlari ko'k»;
**Kasallik**: I**'ve got** a cold / a headache / a temperature / toothache. — o'zbekchada ko'pincha fe'l bilan: «shamolladim», «boshim og'riyapti»;
**Vaqt, ish, reja**: I**'ve got** a meeting at three. We **have** ten minutes.

blocks.text: Yosh **have** bilan emas, **be** bilan aytiladi: «I have 20 years.» → **I'm 20.** (1-dars). Kasallikda esa aksincha — **be** emas, **have**: «I am cold» (sovqotyapman) va **I've got a cold** (shamollaganman) — boshqa-boshqa narsalar.
Inkor: I don't have / I haven't got

Inkor ikki xil yasaladi va bu ikki tizim aralashmaydi. **have** — oddiy fe'l, shuning uchun inkori 6-darsdagidek: **don't / doesn't have**. **have got** da esa **have** yordamchi fe'l vazifasini bajaradi, unga to'g'ridan-to'g'ri **not** qo'shiladi: **haven't / hasn't got**. O'zbekchada ikkalasi ham bitta: «... **yo'q**».

items.text: My sister **hasn't got** a driving licence.

blocks.text: Savol: Do you have ...? / Have you got ...?

Savol ham ikki xil. **have** bilan — 7-darsdagidek **do / does** qo'shiladi: **Do** you **have** a pen? **Does** she **have** children? **have got** bilan esa **have / has** egadan oldinga chiqadi: **Have** you **got** a pen? **Has** she **got** children? Qisqa javob savolning birinchi so'zini takrorlaydi: Do → **I do**, Have → **I have**, Has → **she has**.

items.text: Do you have a car? — No, **I don't**.
Has Emma got a cat? — Yes, **she has**.

blocks.text: have breakfast, have a shower: faqat have

**have** faqat «ega bo'lmoq» emas. Ko'p iboralarda u **harakat**ni bildiradi: ovqatlanmoq, ichmoq, cho'milmoq, dam olmoq. Bunday iboralarda **got ishlatilmaydi**, Present Continuous bo'la oladi (8-dars) va inkor / savol doim **do / does** bilan yasaladi: I **have** breakfast at 7. I**'m having** breakfast now. **Do** you **have** lunch at home? «I've got breakfast at 7» — xato.

rows: **have** a cup of tea / a coffee
**have** a party / a lesson / a meeting
bazm qilmoq / darsi bo'lmoq / yig'ilish o'tkazmoq

blocks.text: O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «I have 20 years.» → **I'm 20.**; «She have a car.» → **She has a car.**; «I'm having a car.» → **I have a car.** (egalik — holat, Continuous emas); «I don't have got» / «Do you have got?» → **I haven't got** / **Have you got?** yoki **I don't have** / **Do you have?**; «Has she got a car? — Yes, she does.» → **Yes, she has.**; «I've got breakfast at eight.» → **I have breakfast at eight.**; «I'm headache.» → **I've got a headache.**

Bitta tizimni tanlang va oxirigacha unga amal qiling: **have** → don't / doesn't / do / does (Do you have? — Yes, I do). **have got** → haven't / hasn't / have / has (Have you got? — Yes, I have). Ovqat, cho'milish, dam olish — doim faqat **have**.

Amerikancha ingliz tilida **have got** kamroq ishlatiladi: amerikaliklar asosan **I have**, **Do you have?** deydi. Ikkalasi ham to'g'ri; Britaniyada **have got** so'zlashuvda, **have** esa yozuvda ko'proq uchraydi. O'tgan zamonda faqat **had** (I **had** a car — «had got» emas) — 11-dars. **have to** (majbur bo'lmoq) — 33-dars; **have** fe'li iboralar bilan batafsil — 58-dars.

examples.title: **have** / **has**: things, family and friends
examples.description: Egalik **have** bilan: I / you / we / they **have**, he / she / it **has**. O'zbekchada «Mening ... **bor**» — inglizchada esa ega + have.

sentences.text: **I have** two brothers and a sister.
sentences.translation: Mening ikkita aka-ukam va bitta opam **bor**.

sentences.text: Madina **has** a beautiful voice.
We **have** a small house with a big garden.
Our city **has** two universities and a famous old market.
sentences.translation: Shahrimizda ikkita universitet va mashhur eski bozor **bor**.

sentences.text: Tom and Sarah **have** three children: two boys and a girl.
sentences.translation: Tom bilan Saraning uchta farzandi **bor**: ikki o'g'il va bir qiz.

sentences.text: My grandfather **has** a lot of old books in his room.
Bekzod **has** a new phone, and he's very happy with it.
sentences.translation: Bekzodning yangi telefoni **bor**, u undan juda xursand.

sentences.text: Every student **has** a card for the library.
This flat **has** a lovely view of the mountains.
Lucky you — you **have** a garden, a dog and a quiet street!
sentences.translation: Omadingiz bor ekan — bog'ingiz, itingiz va tinch ko'changiz **bor**!

examples.title: **have got** / **'ve got** / **'s got**
examples.description: British English'da so'zlashuvda ko'pincha **have got** ishlatiladi — ma'nosi **have** bilan bir xil: I**'ve got** = I have, she**'s got** = she has. Bu yerdagi **'s** — **has**, «is» emas.

sentences.text: **I've got** a new bike.
**She's got** a lovely flat in the centre of London.
We**'ve got** a problem with the car.
Dilnoza **has got** three cousins in Bukhara.
Hurry up! We**'ve got** only ten minutes.
Tom**'s got** a cat and two goldfish.
sentences.translation: Tomning mushugi va ikkita oltin baliqchasi **bor**.

sentences.text: My parents **have got** a little shop near the bazaar.
Sorry, **I've got** a lot of work today.
Our school **has got** a new swimming pool, and it's free for students.
sentences.translation: Maktabimizda yangi **basseyn bor**, u o'quvchilar uchun bepul.

sentences.text: Look, Aziz **has got** a new haircut — it looks great!
sentences.translation: Qara, Aziz sochini yangicha **oldiribdi** — juda zo'r ko'rinadi!

examples.title: **She's got** blue eyes. **I've got** a cold.
examples.description: **have / have got** tashqi ko'rinish (eyes, hair, a beard) va kasallik (a cold, a headache, a temperature) haqida ham ishlatiladi. O'zbekchada kasallik ko'pincha fe'l bilan: «Boshim og'riyapti» → I**'ve got** a headache.

sentences.text: **I've got** a terrible headache.
Emma **has** long red hair and green eyes.
sentences.translation: Emmaning sochi uzun va malla, **ko'zlari** yashil.

sentences.text: My little brother **has got** a cold, so he's at home today.
James **has got** a beard now — he looks older.
sentences.translation: Jeyms endi **soqol qo'ygan** — yoshi kattaroq ko'rinadi.

sentences.text: She**'s got** a high temperature, and her throat hurts.
Aziz **has** dark hair and a big smile.
Poor Bekzod — he**'s got** toothache again.
Both my sisters **have** curly hair, like our mother.
sentences.translation: Ikkala opamning ham onamnikiday jingalak **sochi bor**.

sentences.text: Grandma **has got** a bad back, so she doesn't carry heavy bags.
sentences.translation: Buvimning **beli og'riydi**, shuning uchun og'ir sumka ko'tarmaydi.

sentences.text: Our new teacher **has got** a very loud voice and a funny laugh.
sentences.translation: Yangi o'qituvchimizning **ovozi** juda baland, kulishi esa juda qiziq.

examples.title: Negative: **don't have** / **haven't got**
examples.description: Inkor ikki xil: **have** bilan — **don't / doesn't have**; **have got** bilan — **haven't / hasn't got**. Ikkalasini aralashtirmang: «I don't have got» — xato.

sentences.text: **I don't have** a car, so I take the metro.
Madina **hasn't got** any brothers or sisters.
We **haven't got** time for breakfast — we're late!
This hotel **doesn't have** a restaurant, but there's a café next door.
sentences.translation: Bu mehmonxonada **restoran yo'q**, lekin yonida kafe bor.

sentences.text: Sorry, **I haven't got** any change.
My grandparents **don't have** a computer, and they **don't need** one.
sentences.translation: Bobom va buvimning **kompyuteri yo'q**, ularga kerak ham **emas**.

sentences.text: Tom **doesn't have** much free time because he works two jobs.
sentences.translation: Tomning bo'sh vaqti **ko'p emas**, chunki u ikki joyda ishlaydi.

sentences.text: Our flat **hasn't got** a balcony, but it's got a lovely big kitchen.
sentences.translation: Kvartiramizning **balkoni yo'q**, lekin katta, chiroyli oshxonasi bor.

sentences.text: Don't worry, it isn't serious — you **haven't got** flu, just a cold.
sentences.translation: Xavotir olmang, jiddiy emas — sizda **gripp yo'q**, shunchaki shamollash.

sentences.text: Bekzod **has** a lot of friends, but he **doesn't have** a best friend.
sentences.translation: Bekzodning do'stlari **ko'p**, lekin eng yaqin **do'sti yo'q**.

examples.title: **Do** you **have** ...? / **Have** you **got** ...?
examples.description: Savol ikki xil: **Do** you **have** ...? — Yes, I **do**. / No, I **don't**. **Have** you **got** ...? — Yes, I **have**. / No, I **haven't**. Qisqa javob savolning birinchi so'zi bilan bir xil.

sentences.text: **Do** you **have** a pen? — Yes, I do. Here you are.
**Have** you **got** any brothers? — No, I haven't.
**Does** your flat **have** air conditioning? — Yes, it does.
**Has** Dilnoza **got** a sister? — Yes, she has. Her name's Nodira.
sentences.translation: Dilnozaning opa-singlisi **bormi**? — Ha, bor. Ismi Nodira.

sentences.text: Excuse me, **do** you **have** this shirt in blue?
**Have** they **got** a car? — No, they haven't. They cycle everywhere.
sentences.translation: Ularning mashinasi **bormi**? — Yo'q. Hamma joyga velosipedda borishadi.

sentences.text: Aziz, **have** you **got** your keys? — Yes, I have. They're in my pocket.
**Does** Tom **have** a job? — No, he doesn't. He's still a student.
sentences.translation: Tomning **ishi bormi**? — Yo'q. U hali talaba.

sentences.text: So **have** you **got** any plans for the weekend?
sentences.translation: Xo'sh, dam olish kunlari uchun biror **rejangiz bormi**?

sentences.text: Sorry, **has** this room **got** a fridge? — No, but there's one in the kitchen.
sentences.translation: Kechirasiz, bu xonada **muzlatgich bormi**? — Yo'q, lekin oshxonada bor.

examples.title: **have breakfast**, **have a shower** — no **got**!
examples.description: **have** harakat ma'nosida (ovqatlanmoq, ichmoq, cho'milmoq, dam olmoq) — faqat **have**, **got** qo'shilmaydi. Bu ma'noda Continuous ham bo'ladi (I**'m having** lunch), inkor va savol **do / does** bilan.

sentences.text: We **have breakfast** at seven every morning.
Dad **is having** a shower — he's late for work.
**Do** you **have lunch** at home or at work?
Madina usually **has** a cup of tea after dinner.
sentences.translation: Madina odatda kechki ovqatdan keyin bir piyola **choy ichadi**.

sentences.text: **Have** a good time at the wedding!
The children **are having** a great time at the beach.
Bekzod **doesn't have** dinner before nine o'clock.
sentences.translation: Bekzod soat to'qqizdan oldin kechki **ovqat qilmaydi**.

sentences.text: On Fridays our family **has** plov together at Grandma's.
sentences.translation: Juma kunlari oilamiz buvimnikida birga **osh yeydi**.

sentences.text: Emma is busy — she**'s having** an English lesson until four.
sentences.translation: Emma band — soat to'rtgacha ingliz tili **darsida**.

sentences.text: After a long walk, Tom and I always **have** a rest in the park café.
sentences.translation: Uzoq sayrdan keyin Tom ikkalamiz doim park kafesida **dam olamiz**.

examples.title: Dialogue: at the doctor's
examples.description: Shifokor qabulida: kasallik haqida **have got**, savollar **Have you got ...?** / **Do you have ...?** va qisqa javoblar.

sentences.text: — Good morning! So, what's wrong? **Have** you **got** a pain somewhere?
sentences.translation: — Xayrli tong! Xo'sh, nima bezovta qilyapti? Biror joyingiz **og'riyaptimi**?

sentences.text: — Yes, doctor. **I've got** a sore throat and a bad cough.
sentences.translation: — Ha, doktor. **Tomog'im og'riyapti**, qattiq **yo'tal** ham bor.

sentences.text: — I see. **Have** you **got** a temperature?
— Yes, **I have**. It's about thirty-eight.
— **Do** you **have** any allergies to medicines?
— No, **I don't**. I'm usually very healthy.
— Your throat is very red. **Has** anyone at home **got** the same problem?
sentences.translation: — Tomog'ingiz juda qizargan. Uyda yana kimdadir shunday **muammo bormi**?

sentences.text: — Yes, my wife **has got** a cold too.
— OK. Take this medicine three times a day, and **have** lots of hot drinks.
sentences.translation: — Yaxshi. Bu dorini kuniga uch mahal iching, issiq choyni ham ko'p **iching**.

sentences.text: — Thank you, doctor. **I've got** some honey and lemon at home.
sentences.translation: — Rahmat, doktor. Uyda asal va limon **bor**.

examples.title: Mixed: **have**, **have got** and **have lunch**
examples.description: Mustahkamlash: egalik (have / have got), kasallik, inkor va savollar, have breakfast kabi iboralar aralash.

sentences.text: **I've got** two tickets for the concert — do you want to come?
Sarah **hasn't got** a TV; she **has** lots of books instead.
**Has** your son **got** a fever? — No, he hasn't, but he's very tired.
sentences.translation: O'g'lingizning **isitmasi bormi**? — Yo'q, lekin juda charchagan.

sentences.text: We usually **have** dinner at eight, but tonight we**'re having** it at a restaurant.
sentences.translation: Odatda soat sakkizda kechki **ovqat qilamiz**, lekin bugun restoranda **ovqatlanyapmiz**.

sentences.text: My uncle **has** a farm near Jizzakh with cows and sheep.
sentences.translation: Amakimning Jizzax yaqinida **fermasi bor**, unda sigir va qo'ylar boqiladi.

sentences.text: **Do** you **have** a minute? I**'ve got** a question.
Bekzod **doesn't have** lunch at school; he **has** it at home.
Emma**'s got** a new job, so she **doesn't have** much free time now.
sentences.translation: Emmaning yangi **ishi bor**, shuning uchun hozir bo'sh vaqti **ko'p emas**.

sentences.text: Excuse me, **have** you **got** a map of the city centre?
Madina **has** a cold, so she**'s having** a hot bath and going to bed early.
sentences.translation: Madina **shamollagan**, shuning uchun issiq vannada **cho'milib**, erta yotyapti.
